title: Version 2.1.80 - Enhanced Status Line and Plugin Controls
description: Added rate_limits field to statusline scripts, plugin marketplace source, CLI tool usage detection, effort frontmatter support, and --channels research preview. Fixed numerous bugs and reduced memory usage by ~80MB on startup for large repositories.

community_feedback.quote: #ClaudeCode is all you need in 2026. Claude Code in 2026 is not what it was when it launched. After a year of building frameworks, custom tools, and more

title: Version 2.1.79 Release
description: Added --console flag for Anthropic Console authentication, Show turn duration toggle, and VSCode remote-control feature. Fixed numerous issues including subprocess hanging, Ctrl+C in print mode, voice mode activation, and improved startup memory usage by ~18MB.

title: Persistent Agent Thread Feature (Mobile/Desktop Control)
description: Pro and Max plan users can access a persistent agent thread via Claude Desktop or Claude for iOS/Android to manage tasks in Cowork, extending Claude Code's agentic capabilities to mobile devices.

community_feedback.quote: Reports of code's death are greatly exaggerated - Chris Lattner reviewed a compiler written entirely by Claude AI

title: Voice Mode, Session Forking, and Remote Control
description: Major March 2026 updates bringing Voice Mode with 20-language support and push-to-talk functionality, session forking for isolated sub-agent execution, remote sessions with session teleportation between devices, enhanced transcript search, improved sandbox controls, and customizable keybindings.
